notes: v1.14.593 - A.2 SHIP 2: THE BLOCKERS ADAPTER, A DERIVED OPEN-BLOCKER COUNT, AND THE GAPS LIST. Handoff docs/SHIP-HANDOFF-A2-ASSEMBLER.md section 5; rulings OWNER-RULINGS.md 2026-09-17 (Q-10 to Q-17 as recommended, Q-A separate gaps list, Ship 2 gated on Chromium); evidence docs/A2-SHIP2-EVIDENCE.md.  WHAT A TECHNICIAN SEES: nothing, unless the page is opened with ?rrdev=1. No nav entry, no dock change, no other surface touched. In the ?rrdev=1 readout the coverage line gains a blockers row, the rack gap moves to its own gold line (gaps: rack - ...), and the Record's status.openBlockers is a number.  WHAT IT IS. A third adapter, blockers, reads phantom_blockers_v1 through the assembler's own raw reader, never through PHANTOM_BLOCKERS or safeGet, and matches records to the rack by exact composite key. It emits blocker.opened at openedAt and blocker.cleared at clearedAt. A migrated record, or one with no numeric open time, is counted but never put on the timeline, and the blockers coverage row says so. status.openBlockers is derived in the assembler: open records from the events plus those undated records, 0 when the store holds nothing for the rack, null when it cannot be read. Coverage is now exactly one row per registered adapter; Ship 1's rack note moves unchanged into a new top-level gaps list; the schema stays rr-1. Known and ruled (Q-10): UNBLOCK does not close the blocker record, so after an UNBLOCK the readout still counts it while the Build card does not. No storage writer, renderer, blocker_save, deploy_advancePhase or deploy_countBlockers is changed.  PROOF, on laptop-chromium by owner ruling because Windows Smart App Control blocks Playwright WebKit on this machine (0xC0E90002; a forced reinstall did not clear it). test/e2e/65-rack-record-assembler.spec.js: RED on .592, 11 failed for the missing feature and the 7 untouched Ship 1 tests passed; GREEN 18/18; the seven planned mutations each caught (M6 only by the added undated-shapes test), each restored byte-exact. After UNBLOCK the readout still reads 1 with no blocker.cleared: recorded, not a FAIL. The BUILD dock badge staying hidden is not a FAIL.
